source: private cached rasters of the sealed A01 package (gapset cache, 21 assets: attic plan 853 px, ground plan, 4 elevations 1280 x 630, section) read locally; no download, no OCR run, no publisher pixel in the repository; OWNER ZIP and 005w-renders.zip not used as input

sourceFacts.atticPlan: west gable: 2 openings printed 110/220 (rooms 8 and 7); east gable: 2 openings printed 100/220 (room 3 and room 4); 7 rooflight symbols 78/118: 4 on the rear slope (x ~2.8, 4.6, 7.8, 8.6 m), 3 on the front slope (x ~2.8, 7.8, 8.6 m)
sourceFacts.elevations: the two SIDE_UNSPECIFIED elevations: ...4f52 has two tall windows off-axis close together and one ground window = EAST; ...5ec6 has two tall windows symmetric about the axis and the terrace glazing with a pergola = WEST. Front: 3 rooflights on the slope at x 2.8 / 7.7 / 8.6; rear: 4 at 2.6 / 4.6 / 7.7 / 8.6. Front and rear each show 3 chimney tops at x ~3.4-3.95, 6.2-6.9, 9.15-10.24
sourceFacts.identity: the same object in two views is the same opening: its plan gap and the opening over it on the elevation at the column the registration puts it; the side identity is decided by which wall's gaps a view shows, for both side views together

causes: attic plan registered by an 8 %-agreement wall-pair fit at scale 0.923 (outer faces refused: 3.7 % anisotropy because the world depth is 8.008 m on a 408 px outline the plan prints as 830): the east gable line fell on white paper 40 px outside the drawn wall, so the east wall read no gaps; west gaps were up to 0.35 m off

the base side registration put the EAST elevation (...4f52) on the WEST wall ('first free one', confidence 0.4); the WEST elevation (...5ec6) was refused (its silhouette, with the pergola and terrace, is 16.2 m) - this is the '~100 px offset' of 005W
side views were scaled on their silhouette (0.016179 m/px; true sheet scale 0.01704) with the ridge put on the silhouette top, which is a chimney top (row 111; the gable apex is ~row 119)
the east callout reads 100/70 at confidence 0.24, and none of its height readings is 220
